Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 1979
LAND REFORMS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance to amend the
Land Reforms Act, 1977
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 18th August 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Land Reforms (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 3, Act II of 1977

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 1979
LAND REFORMS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance to amend the
Land Reforms Act, 1977
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 18th August 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :‑
2. Amendment of section 3,
Act II of 1977.‑In
the Land Reforms Act, 1977 (II of 1977), hereinafter referred to as the said
Act, in section 3, for the word "No" the words and comma "Save
as otherwise provided in this Act, no" shall be substituted.

Amendment of section 17, Act II of 1977

ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXXVII OF 1979
LAND REFORMS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance to amend the
Land Reforms Act, 1977
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 18th August 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :‑
3. Amendment of section 17,
Act II of 1977.‑In
the said Act, in section 17,‑
(a) in clause (d), for the full‑stop at the end
a colon shall be substituted; and
(b) after clause (d), amended as aforesaid, the
following proviso shall be added, namely :‑
"Provided that if, in the public interest, the
Provincial Government decides to lease out any such land, the person by whom it
was surrendered shall have the right of first option to the grant of lease of
the land or of such portion thereof as the Provincial Government may deem
fit."
